correctness.rationale: The leaf-addition Wiener recurrence and fixed-label distance-sum recursion are proved from independent uniform parent choices; conditional perturbation propagates by an exact telescoping product. Harmonic monotonicity and asymptotic differences prove the sign transition. Mixed covariance uses independence and two finite telescoping identities. Direct exhaustive rational verification covers all 46,233 recursive trees up to size 9; larger finite checks supplement the all-size proof. Cases i=2,3 and v=1 are included.

value.rationale: The full sample-size- and parent-age-resolved response of the globally meaningful Wiener index to a single local recursive-tree attachment has a sharp change of sign at asymptotic parent fraction 1/e. Summing this response yields a nontrivial exact negative root-degree/Wiener covariance with a zeta-value limiting constant. The phenomenon is not a routine marginal normalization or trivial pathwise monotonicity.
